title: M2 L3 Part 2 — Bakery day-at-work (to-infinitive adverb/adj, Scene 1+2)
readingPassages: Part 2 — パン店での職場体験
Small Talk: 好きなパンについて、ペアで話してみよう。
Scene 1 — 花がパン店で由香さんと話す（職場体験）
Question: 花たちが忙しかったのはなぜですか。
Check — to + 動詞（副詞用法・形容詞用法）:
Many customers came to the shop to buy lunch.
（副詞用法）…するために　（形容詞用法）…するための〜／…すべき〜
I listen to music to relax.
I study English to communicate with people around the world.
I use the internet to get information.
Scene 2 — 休憩時間、由香さんが花たちに話す
Question: パン店では毎日何種類のパンを焼いていますか。
My bakery provides twenty kinds of bread. I bake them several times a day. That way, even when customers come late, they have plenty of choices. My customers are happy with my shop.

However, I sometimes have leftovers and throw them away. I don't want to waste anything. To solve this problem, I discount my bread after six o'clock. This helps, but it's not enough. I still have many things to do.
Listen & Read: 困っていること → throw away leftovers / 考えられる原因 → provide many kinds of bread, bake several times a day
Think about Yourself: 食べ残しなどを減らすために、あなたはどんなことをしていますか。
